boundary: Example-backed ASCII STRING literal decoding. No file/compiler/controller operations from the reference example are implemented or executed, and no new controller output-format behavior is inferred.

rules.documented: The STRING entry uses apostrophe-delimited ASCII literals. Figure A.20.4 writes a KAREL source line containing a quoted hello-world value by doubling the embedded source apostrophes.
rules.implemented: One STRING token may contain doubled apostrophes. Each pair decodes to one logical apostrophe before constant evaluation, type/capacity checks, comparisons, concatenation, character/string builtins, routine inputs and unformatted output. Empty, boundary and consecutive apostrophe contents are handled as logical data.
rules.restriction: The escape rule is derived from the documented example; fresh KAREL compiler/runtime acceptance is not claimed. ASCII-only values, STRING function-result/writable-value restrictions, and existing logical capacity guards remain. Backslash escape processing and implicit concatenation of whitespace-separated literals are not introduced.
rules.tests: tests/test_literal_apostrophes.py: manual text, empty/boundary/repeated quotes, constants, comparisons, lengths, truncation, arrays/structures, parameters and inert code-like contents

rules.implemented: Raw token text and physical line/column positions remain unchanged. Parser reports retain raw token length, decoded length and escaped-apostrophe count per literal. Token continuation can only join complete source tokens; it cannot split or fuse quoted literals.
rules.restriction: Literals cannot span physical newline/form-feed boundaries. Comments/directives are not decoded as STRING data. Unmatched quotes and non-ASCII contents remain rejected. No physical token is reconstructed by unescaping across a continuation.
rules.tests: tests/test_literal_apostrophes.py: raw token/location metadata, source maps, complete-token continuation, fusion/multiline/unmatched/non-ASCII guards

rules.implemented: Unformatted and existing unquoted formatted STRING WRITE consume decoded logical contents through the existing recorder/callback contract. The example records three exact texts, including the manual generated-source line, and checks injected output independently.
rules.restriction: Quoted WRITE containing embedded apostrophes remains rejected before requesting output. Quoted truncation/fallback, files, TRANSLATE, LOAD, CALL_PROG, controller buffering and runtime execution remain unsupported. Only literal text is taken from the manual example.
